observations: White electric sewing machine with a digital control panel.
The machine is shown with a foot pedal and power cord.
The background is a tiled wall with a repeating pattern.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ISAAC JAMIS' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The machine appears clean, but its age cannot be confirmed from a single photo.
There is no video or photo of the machine powered on or stitching fabric.
The machine's stitch selection buttons are visible, but the actual stitches being produced are not shown.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and successfully sewing a line of stitches.

risks.risk: The digital display may be non-functional or the stitch selection buttons may be broken.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the machine's display showing the current stitch length and the buttons being pressed.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the bobbin case or bobbins may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine with the bobbin area open.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and sewing a line of stitches.
Photo of the machine with the bobbin case open.
Photo of the machine's display showing the stitch length and buttons being pressed.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
